limitations: Device intrinsics, lens distortion and hand-eye calibration were not recorded in this dataset.
These annotations test the supplied CAD with the explicitly configured camera model; they do not fit camera poses or change physical dimensions.
Manual uncertainty describes image annotation, not unknown camera or geometry error.
No real photograph or video frame is embedded in this file. Optional hashes identify local reference PNG files only.

overhead_table_edges.method: Manually associated horizontal desk edges; absolute row-gradient maxima within the stated unoccluded image ROIs.
association_limits: The real desk has rounded corners; the CAD desk has sharp corners. No exact corner correspondence is claimed.
Only a small unobstructed portion of the near edge is visible.
Black robot mounting plates and desk clamps have no identified matching source CAD geometry; their corners are not calibration points.

wrist_gripper_tips.width_source: Diagnostic 75.2 mm opening from the collector's normalized gripper convention; not a measured hardware travel limit.
wrist_gripper_tips.method: Manual uppermost visible fingertip silhouette positions, checked in an enlarged view.
association_limits: Visible silhouettes are not fiducials. Actual finger geometry, rounded edges and partial occlusion may affect the association.
Only the vertical silhouette residual is scored; lateral coordinates are reported for inspection, not used to infer gripper travel.
The six arm joints transform the camera and fingers together and cannot explain a camera-relative fingertip projection discrepancy.
One static wrist view cannot distinguish intrinsic calibration error, hand-eye pose error and finger shape mismatch.
